The '''Fungus Pit''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in [[Bashka]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. It operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
The Fungus Pit was one of the most popular places to hang out in Bashka. It was owned and run by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Cheib'Kalla]], and most of the staff were good-looking Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|females]], whom he had hired as a means of protecting them from [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. He also employed three [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisks]], [[Dovoul]], [[Jebbis]] and [[Gatwer]], as bouncers and the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Fitre]] as a bartender.

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited the Fungus Pit. While they were there, the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] slaver [[Noric Gestal]] and about two dozen other slavers attempted to capture the female Twi'lek staff members, to sell into slavery. However, the heroes and some of the other patrons of the bar attacked the slavers and were able to save the Twi'leks.
